en: Awaiting orders, sir. On your command, I shall unleash hell upon them!
These woods make my tusks itch...
I have lost my Band of Unending Life. Are you able to replace it for me?
Please cast a high priority DEBUFF spell on all nearby targets.
If overalls are held up by the snaps at the top, then why do they have belt loops?
Clever, mortals - but I am not so easily lured away from my sanctum!
Oh, Darrowshire!  I would give a thousand lives for you!

A Horde Commendation Signet is awarded to a $g hero : heroine; who goes above and beyond the call of duty to the Horde.  Various Commendation Officers for the factions of the Horde are located in all of the major cities; speak with the one with whom you'd like to raise your reputation, and give them the number of signets they ask for!$B$BBy the way, during the war effort here, if you'd rather receive a material reward for your signets instead of reputation, seek out Warlord Gorchuk.

Och!  Ye should be careful what ye get enchanted $glad : lass;.  I had me mug enchanted so it wouldn't spill a drop, but now I can't drink from it!  Such a tragedy.  

You be sure to heed me advice when ye see Gimble.  He'll be in his shop right by the Gryphon Master at The Great Forge.
Because you are still alive and my hands aren't gripped firmly around your stubby little neck.
The rage burning within you will soon find fuel in our enemies.

Invention, my dear $c, is two percent bottled inspiration, four percent solar exposure, six percent chance of thunderstorms clearing by mid-afternoon, and ninety-three percent Rumplesnicker.$B$BWait, did that add to one hundred? I've got my notes around here somewhere.
This Dimensional Imploder sounds dangerous! How can I make one?
Hello there! My name's Jenna! And you?
We must not give into the evil which has darkened our land.  The Night Watch must prevail!

You are going to love this story, $r. See, here is the thing. As soon as Malygos charged me with protecting the scepter shard, I knew I was in for an eternity of headache and pain.$B$BAll I want to do is study these magic rich shorelines and take in what artifacts might remain from the Sundering. You know, there was once a thriving Highborne civilization here! You don't have to tell me that there is going to be some solid magical items around here, $r. I can smell it!
Darkmoon Dogs fresh off the grill.  Come and get em while they're hot!
...Nine...Ten...Ready or not.  Here I come!
FER KHAZ'MODAN!
Why is it that there's never a gyrochronatom lying around when you need one?
I... I feel... I feel the touch of Elune upon my being once more... She smiles upon me... Yes... I...
I think I've lost my  Zandalar Vindicator's Belt. Can you help?

Hello, $c. From what I've been told, everything's been collected, and all of the materiel for the war is being shipped over to Silithus as we speak. It should all be there in less than a day. Once that's done, and the gong has been rung with the Scepter of the Shifting Sands, the war will really begin.
Very well, Proudtusk, you may begin your march. Carry on!
Greetings, $c. Is there something I can help you with?
Good luck. Sorry I can't take you with me!
